entries.title: Job 18:1
segments: ¶Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:

entries.title: Job 18:2
segments: "How long [till] you put an end to words? Gain understanding, and afterward we will speak.

entries.title: Job 18:3
segments: Why are we counted as beasts, [And] regarded as stupid in your sight?

entries.title: Job 18:4
segments: You who tear yourself in anger, Shall the earth be forsaken for you? Or shall the rock be removed from its place?

entries.title: Job 18:5
segments: ¶"The light of the wicked indeed goes out, And the flame of his fire does not shine.

entries.title: Job 18:6
segments: The light is dark in his tent, And his lamp beside him is put out.

entries.title: Job 18:7
segments: The steps of his strength are shortened, And his own counsel casts him down.

entries.title: Job 18:8
segments: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walks into a snare.

entries.title: Job 18:9
segments: The net takes [him] by the heel, [And] a snare lays hold of him.

entries.title: Job 18:10
segments: A noose [is] hidden for him on the ground, And a trap for him in the road.

entries.title: Job 18:11
segments: ¶Terrors frighten him on every side, And drive him to his feet.

entries.title: Job 18:12
segments: His strength is starved, And destruction [is] ready at his side.

entries.title: Job 18:13
segments: It devours patches of his skin; The firstborn of death devours his limbs.

entries.title: Job 18:14
segments: He is uprooted from the shelter of his tent, And they parade him before the king of terrors.

entries.title: Job 18:15
segments: They dwell in his tent [who are] none of his; Brimstone is scattered on his dwelling.

entries.title: Job 18:16
segments: His roots are dried out below, And his branch withers above.

entries.title: Job 18:17
segments: The memory of him perishes from the earth, And he has no name among the renowned.

entries.title: Job 18:18
segments: He is driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.

entries.title: Job 18:19
segments: He has neither son nor posterity among his people, Nor any remaining in his dwellings.

entries.title: Job 18:20
segments: Those in the west are astonished at his day, As those in the east are frightened.

entries.title: Job 18:21
segments: Surely such [are] the dwellings of the wicked, And this [is] the place [of him] who does not know God."
